label: G F38#27 live-vs-arm
brief: Two interface screens from the game: the settings controls list (top) and the quick-item bindings list (bottom). Judge the interface: whether the control and binding text is easy to scan at a glance, the binding cells and key labels are easy to read, and it fits the game's UI direction.
defects: Dense gray-on-navy control instructions and literal key labels make settings and quick binding text hard to scan
